block.ficsitcraft.hub.desc: FICSIT headquarters. Submit parts here to complete milestones.
block.ficsitcraft.storage_container.desc: 27 slots. Accepts items from belts on every side.
block.ficsitcraft.miner_mk1.desc: Place on a resource node. 30/60/120 items/min (impure/normal/pure). 5 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.miner_mk2.desc: Place on a resource node. 60/120/240 items/min. 12 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.foundry.desc: Combines two resources into alloys (steel). 16 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.constructor.desc: Turns one input into one part. 4 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.assembler.desc: Assembles two parts into a new one. 15 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.manufacturer.desc: Builds complex parts from up to four inputs. 55 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.biomass_burner.desc: Burns leaves, wood, biomass or solid biofuel. 30 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.coal_generator.desc: Burns coal. Needs 45 m³/min of water through a pipeline. 75 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.splitter.desc: Input at the back, splits evenly to left, front and right.
block.ficsitcraft.merger.desc: Inputs on back, left and right; outputs at the front.
item.ficsitcraft.raw_quartz.desc: Processed into Quartz Crystals and Silica.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.node: Infinite. Right-click to hand-mine, or place a Miner on top.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.power_pole: Up to %s power line connections. Height: %s blocks.
message.ficsitcraft.pole_no_space: Not enough space! The pole needs %s free blocks upwards.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.creative_generator: Testing only: %s MW without fuel. Creative mode only.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.creative_generator_u: Right-click: reset the fuse and show the grid state.
message.ficsitcraft.creative_only: The Creative Generator can only be placed in creative mode!
tooltip.ficsitcraft.cable: Right-click two power connectors to string a power line (1 cable / 10 blocks).
tooltip.ficsitcraft.cable2: Sneak + right-click: remove all lines of a connector.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.belt_lift: Curves and ramps connect automatically like rails. Sneak-place for a vertical lift.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.build_gun: Right-click to open the build menu and construct unlocked buildings.
message.ficsitcraft.welcome: [FICSIT] Welcome, Pioneer! Place your HUB, hand-mine resource nodes and complete milestones. Use the Build Gun to construct buildings.
message.ficsitcraft.miner_needs_node: Miners must be placed directly on a resource node!
message.ficsitcraft.line_start: Power line started. Right-click a second connector.
message.ficsitcraft.line_invalid: The first connector no longer exists.
message.ficsitcraft.tiers_1_2: [FICSIT] Tier 1 and Tier 2 are now available in the HUB!
message.ficsitcraft.tiers_3_4: [FICSIT] Space Elevator Phase 1 delivered! Tier 3 and Tier 4 are now available.
message.ficsitcraft.victory: [FICSIT] Project Assembly Phase 2 delivered. FICSIT thanks you for your efficiency, Pioneer!
milestone.ficsitcraft.hub_upgrade_3.desc: Constructor, Biomass Burner, Power Poles, Concrete.
milestone.ficsitcraft.logistics_mk2.desc: Conveyor Belt Mk.2, Power Pole Mk.2 and the Zipline.
milestone.ficsitcraft.project_phase_1.de: Deliver Smart Plating to unlock Tier 3 and Tier 4.
milestone.ficsitcraft.coal_power.desc: Coal Generator, Water Extractor, Pipelines, Pipeline Pump, Fluid Buffer.
milestone.ficsitcraft.basic_steel.desc: Foundry, Steel Beams and Pipes, Versatile Framework.
milestone.ficsitcraft.improved_logistics: Miner Mk.2, Belt Mk.3, Power Pole Mk.3.
milestone.ficsitcraft.caterium_quartz.de: Caterium Ingots, Quickwire, Quartz Crystals, Silica.
milestone.ficsitcraft.railway_tech.desc: Railway, Train Station, Empty Platform, Locomotive, Freight Car, Block Signal.
milestone.ficsitcraft.train_logistics.de: Freight Platform, Fluid Freight Platform, Fluid Freight Car, Path Signal.
milestone.ficsitcraft.project_phase_2.de: The final delivery. FICSIT is watching.
message.ficsitcraft.no_space: Not enough space for this building!
block.ficsitcraft.pipeline_pump.desc: In-line pump: pushes fluid from back to front with 20 blocks of head lift. 4 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.water_extractor.desc: Place over water (or lava). 120 m³/min into pipelines, 10 blocks head lift. 20 MW.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.pipe2: Right-click: info · Sneak + right-click: flush network
tooltip.ficsitcraft.zipline: Jump into a power line (or right-click one) to ride it. W/S to move along it.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.zipline2: Transfers at poles automatically · Space: jump off · Sneak: let go
message.ficsitcraft.extractor_needs_wate: The Water Extractor must be placed over water or lava!
gui.ficsitcraft.water_tank: Water %s / %s m³ (uses %s m³/min at full load)
block.ficsitcraft.fluid_buffer.desc: Stores 400 m³ of fluid. Connect pipelines to any side; it fills from above its level and drains below it.
gui.ficsitcraft.scan.title: Resource Scanner
block.ficsitcraft.train_station.desc: Named stop of the railway (5x9). Trains dock here; connect power to run locomotives. Right-click to rename. 20 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.freight_platform.desc: Loads / unloads docked freight cars (belts on both sides). Sneak + right-click: switch load / unload. 10 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.fluid_freight_platform: Pumps fluid between pipelines and docked fluid freight cars. Sneak + right-click: switch load / unload. 10 MW.
block.ficsitcraft.empty_platform.desc: A plain railway platform that continues the line between other platforms.
item.ficsitcraft.railway.desc: Lay tracks with two clicks. Curves bend by themselves.
item.ficsitcraft.locomotive.desc: Draws up to 110 MW from the railway power network.
item.ficsitcraft.freight_car.desc: 36 item slots. Sneak + right-click on the car to open it.
item.ficsitcraft.fluid_freight_car.desc: Carries up to 800 m³ of fluid.
item.ficsitcraft.rail_signal_block.desc: Splits the line into blocks: a train only enters a block that is free.
item.ficsitcraft.rail_signal_path.desc: Reserves the whole route through a junction so crossing trains do not block each other.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.railway: Right-click the ground to start, right-click again to finish a track.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.railway2: Snaps to track ends, branches off tracks. 1 Railway per 6 blocks. X: dismantle.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.locomotive: Electric locomotive. Needs a powered Train Station on the network.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.vehicle_place: Right-click next to a track to put it on the rails; next to a train it couples on.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.signal_block: A train only enters a block that no other train is in.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.signal_path: Reserves the route through junctions for one train at a time.
tooltip.ficsitcraft.signal_place: Right-click a track: guards trains running the way you look. X: dismantle.
message.ficsitcraft.rail_no_free_side: This track end has no free side.
message.ficsitcraft.rail_start: Start set. Click where the track should end.
message.ficsitcraft.rail_occupied: A train is on that track!
message.ficsitcraft.rail_problem_bad_ang: Angle not possible - the track would double back.
message.ficsitcraft.rail_problem_same_no: That is the same track end.
message.ficsitcraft.rail_problem_same_tr: Both ends are on the same track.
message.ficsitcraft.vehicle_no_room: There is not enough track here.
message.ficsitcraft.signal_needs_track: There is no track on that side.
message.ficsitcraft.signal_exists: There already is a signal of this kind.
message.ficsitcraft.no_timetable: Add stops to the timetable first.
message.ficsitcraft.nothing_to_couple: No train close enough to couple.
hud.ficsitcraft.train_controls: W/S throttle - Space brake - H horn - G menu - Shift leave
gui.ficsitcraft.station.title: Train Station
gui.ficsitcraft.station.name: Station name
gui.ficsitcraft.train.title: Train
gui.ficsitcraft.train.name: Train name
